svg.title: JDBC Lettuce Redis Cache Architecture
svg.desc: JDBC Lettuce architecture rebuilt from exposed-jdbc-lettuce README, repository, loader, and writer source files.
svg.text: A JDBC repository pair coordinates Lettuce Redis loaded maps, optional suspend NearCache, and Exposed transaction loaders/writers.

g.text: Exposed JDBC loader and writer path
Use this view to locate cache ownership: sync goes through LettuceLoadedMap; suspend may add a local NearCache front.
Loader and writer cards are the Exposed JDBC bridge used when Redis misses, writes through, writes behind, or deletes rows.
